name: scroll-stopper
description: Scroll Stopper — turn any book manuscript into ready-to-post 9:16 slideshow reels with AI-generated images, genre + pairing-aware text hooks, platform-specific captions and hashtags, optional music, optional AI voiceover narration (ElevenLabs), Dropbox auto-upload, and a Metricool-ready scheduler CSV. Built for indie authors who want consistent BookTok/Reels content without the design work.
